inputs: An explicit required-capability list from a task or a gap
invariants: A Capability record has no provided_by field; providers are derived from the org registry on demand.
comprises and requires must be acyclic; related_to is symmetric so a cycle in it is the normal case.
Active capacity and organizational capability are separate: a dormant provider is coverage, not capacity.
Candidate, shadow and probation providers count as neither - the person under evaluation is not the answer to the gap.
A required capability that is not registered raises rather than becoming a gap; a typo must not become a hire.
purpose: Defines what the company can do, relates capabilities explicitly, and derives who provides each one from org_registry.yaml rather than storing a second copy.
risks: Registry JSON is generated; hand-editing it can break the byte-stable round trip test.
expand() turns one requirement into several, which turns one honest gap into several invented ones if used by default.
title: Capability model and coverage
